description: This file defines multiple specialized EventSource classes used for diagnostics and logging in the Orleans runtime system. It contains internal event sources for callback data, outside runtime clients, dispatcher, inside runtime clients, and incoming message agents, each with methods to write specific events.

classes.name: OrleansCallBackDataEvent
classes.description: EventSource for callback-related diagnostics within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: OrleansOutsideRuntimeClientEvent
classes.description: EventSource for diagnostics related to outside runtime client activities.

classes.name: OrleansInsideRuntimeClientEvent
classes.description: EventSource for inside runtime client diagnostics.

classes.name: OrleansIncomingMessageAgentEvent
classes.description: EventSource for incoming message agent diagnostics.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Logs a timeout event, invoked when a request timeout occurs.

methods.name: OnTargetSiloFail
methods.description: Logs an event when a target silo fails.

methods.name: DoCallback
methods.description: Logs that a callback request has been completed.

methods.name: OnCanceled
methods.description: Logs that a request was canceled.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Logs sending a request in outside runtime client.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Logs receiving a response in outside runtime client.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Logs sending a response in outside runtime client.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs receiving a message in the dispatcher.
